audit_items.proof_trace: The enforcement mechanism is the `if (!debt.has_debt()) { wit_table::remove(...) }` check at L189-191, which runs after every debt update. In the full-repay branch (debt_amount <= amount), `debt.cleared()` sets amount to float::zero(), making has_debt() false and triggering removal. In the partial branch (debt_amount > amount), mathematical proof shows self.amount.value > amount*WAD, so unsafe_decrease always produces a positive result and the entry is correctly retained. No other code path can leave a zero-amount debt in the table.
